independent_proxy.contract: global Pearson correlation over a fixed common full-support voxel set, with SciPy trilinear fixed-image sampling and a bounded translation-only search; this is not the Flashalign sampled patch-mixture objective
independent_proxy.inference: For all four stored sqrt-contrast cases, the independent NCC/trilinear proxy improves outside the 0.1 mm gate. Continuous fixed evaluation and an affine same-modality contrast counterfactual keep the proxy optimum near truth. This falsifies the old court premise for a related estimator without substituting the proxy for Flashalign's exact objective.

numerical_explanation: At moving point x the stored moving value is a nonlinear signed-square-root transform of the continuous phantom at T x, while the optimizer samples a trilinear interpolant of separately sampled fixed values at T x. Nonlinear contrast, discrete sampling, hard background support and trilinear interpolation do not commute, so geometric truth need not be an NCC optimum at 0.1 mm.
